name: Patrick "gigstorm" Kiley
biography: Patrick Kiley is a Security Consultant doing embedded security testing and has over 20 years of information security experience. Patrick has performed research in avionics security, vehicles, and even managed to brick his Tesla making it go faster. Patrick has a patent pending on a embedded security access tool and loves tearing things apart while figuring out how they work.
